{{Top|leg}}
'''Silencers''' were weapon attachments placed on the barrel of a [[Slugthrower/Legends|slugthrower]]. The attachment deadened the sound of the weapon firing, which made it a favorite of [[Special forces/Legends|special forces]]. Many weapons used by [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Alliance Special Forces]] were fitted with silencers, such as the [[Adjudicator (slugthrower)|Adjudicator]] and the [[SH-9 slugthrower pistol/Legends|SH-9 slugthrower pistol]]. [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn]] manufactured the [[NonSonic Silencer]].<ref name="ROE">''[[Rules of Engagement: The Rebel SpecForce Handbook]]''</ref>
